risk_note: RV1 paths (catalog/favorites, favorites.controller) with rule tests (test/spec, RV2 by PR): the favorites writes now run inside the platform idempotency transaction (executeInTransaction), closing B1-28c's code-review finding (a crash between the business commit and the completed record could replay a delete). The outer transaction reaches addFavorite / removeFavorite / removeFavorites through AsyncLocalStorage (their call shape is pinned by B1-28c's frozen tests); the per-user lock comes first in that transaction; the favorites cap is read before the transaction opens so a transaction never asks the pool for a second connection (Codex review r1 S2, fixed in round 2). Two mechanical fixture fixes by the orchestrator (db-kit.ts used a structural type instead of importing @couli/db/testing; [AC-B1-28e#6] seeded ids colliding with an earlier case, found by CI verify-int). Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
